title: Case: Return approved but the customer has no return label
context: The merchant approved a return, but has not issued its printable label. A real synthetic label facsimile is included for exercise completeness, not actual shipping.
initial_request: The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.

events.body:
Return RT-5305 for TG-7017 / DL-6382 is approved. The label field is empty. Our authorised label team needs to issue the label against RT-5305 before the customer can prepare the return.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-718.txt
The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.

attachments.name: label-scan-718.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-30161
Consignee: Dervla Blackwood
Address: 5 Harrow Close
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2027-03-03T09:00:00Z

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant's returns team to issue the missing label.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Hartwold Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant's returns team to issue the missing label. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Label issuance is not return collection, warehouse receipt or refund.
Treats label-scan-718.txt as evidence about DL-6382: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-30161)
Tells anyone that DL-6382 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-718.txt
expected.reference_message: Please issue the missing printable return label for RT-5305, matching TG-7017 and original shipment DL-6382. Send it in the verified returns thread.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-031: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-718.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-30161); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
